svg.title: Single-Storey House with Garage — floor plan
svg.desc: Three-bedroom single-storey house. Entry Porch opens into Bedroom 1, which connects to the Hall. The Hall serves all three bedrooms, Bathroom, Living Room and Kitchen. Kitchen connects to the Attached Garage.
svg.text: Single-storey house · 3 bedrooms · 103.8 m² · dimensions in metres to wall centre-lines
